name: std::iter_swap

declarations.code:
template <class ForwardIt1, class ForwardIt2>

void iter_swap(ForwardIt1 a, ForwardIt2 b);

intro:
Swaps the values of the elements the given iterators are pointing to.

If any of the following conditions is satisfied, the behavior is undefined:

a or b is not dereferenceable.
 *a is not Swappable with *b.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
a, b

 -

 iterators to the elements to swap


 Type requirements


 -ForwardIt1, ForwardIt2 must meet the requirements of LegacyForwardIterator.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function template models the semantics of the swap operation given by Swappable. That is, overloads of swap found by ADL and the fall back of std::swap are considered.

sections.title: Possible implementation

summary: Swaps the values of the elements the given iterators are pointing to.
